Name: Stacked Item Icons
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
With this mod, items stacked over 100 will show as three overlapped instances of the item and items stacked between 10 - 99 will show as two overlapped instances of the item in inventory menus.

You can change the minimum amounts for double and triple stack and the spacing between the instances in the config.

A list of objects that are allowed to stack is saved in the mod's folder to "[b]allow_list.json[/b]". The file contains the names of objects that the mod has encountered by playing the game, each set to [b]true[/b] by default. changing any entry to [b]false[/b] will cause it not to ever be shown as a stack. You can make the mod reload the file in-game by opening the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] page for this mod.


[size=5][b]Config[/b]
[/size]
You can customize this mod by editing the config file or using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
